title: Understanding the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix $H$ is used in linear regression to project the observed values onto the fitted values. It is defined as $H=X(X**TX)**{-1}X**T$. This matrix has some interesting properties, such as being symmetric and idempotent.

title: Orthogonality Concept
text: Orthogonality in linear algebra means that two vectors are perpendicular to each other. If $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$ is orthogonal to the column space of $X$, it means that the residuals are perpendicular to the space spanned by the predictors.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: Which of the following is a property of the hat matrix $H$?

hintAnswer: The residuals are perpendicular to the space spanned by the predictors.
title: Understanding $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$
text: What does it mean for $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$ to be orthogonal to the column space of $X$?
choices: The residuals are perpendicular to the space spanned by the predictors.
The residuals are parallel to the space spanned by the predictors.
The residuals are within the space spanned by the predictors.
